headline: Dangote Refinery Plans to Raise IPO Size to $2.1 Billion Following $4.5 Billion Demand
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery plans to expand its initial public offering size from $1.62 billion to $2.1 billion after securing nearly $4.5 billion in investor demand.
why: Dangote Petroleum Refinery in Nigeria is the largest single-train oil refinery in Africa, impacting regional fuel trade.
